# TBD Field Manual

The field manual is the single source of truth for how this unit fights. Where a mission briefing contradicts it, the briefing wins for that operation only.

## 1. Chain of command

Platoon staff issue intent, not instructions. Squad leads own execution inside their assigned boundary.

## 2. Movement

- Default formation is a staggered column on roads, wedge in the open.
- Bounding overwatch inside 400 m of a suspected contact.
- Nobody crosses a linear danger area without near-side security set.

## 3. Contact drills

On contact: return fire, take cover, report. In that order. The contact report is `CONTACT — direction — distance — description`.

## 4. Casualties

Stabilise where the casualty falls only if the position is covered. Otherwise drag to cover first. Medics do not move forward of the base of fire.
